"""Publish only the complete prerequisite and predecessor acceptance guide."""
import argparse
import gzip
import json
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path
from common import BASE, OWNER, REVISION, need, pin, save
from intake import git

CHAPTER=Path('docs/book/src/13k-isf-feature-support-matrix.md')
REGISTRY=Path('doctrine/live_document_size/surfaces.jsonl')
ANCHOR='visual acceptance. Complete raw-stack joining remains next.\n\n'
TRANSFORMS={
    'scripts/run_with_ram_guard.sh -- python3 -B docs/audits/observer-display-contract-20261010/verify.py':
    'scripts/run_with_ram_guard.sh -- python3 -B docs/audits/raw-stack-prerequisites-20261011/display_checkpoint.py --replay'}
ADDITION='''The raw-stack prerequisite reader now qualifies the unchanged broader observer
and class/frame contracts together. Every completed child retains its original
acceptance. Complete primary, source, parser, public framework, observer, header,
coordinate and address readers execute in their declared source or dated role.
The source class, guard, first cause and each ordered throw phase join every
complete source function, argument and original full header role.

For example, a borrowed whole frame can preserve plausible call syntax while
belonging to another caller. The source/phase/header association rejects it.
Missing children, narrowed acceptance, changed first causes, wrong argument
roles and native-class promotion also reject. The separate full-header lexical
reader supplies quoting and truncation controls; these checks share qualified
source models and do not claim a universal or native identity oracle.

A prerequisite census also found an earlier coordinate draft archive required
by its committed catalog but absent from Git. Its exact whole bytes and every
named member now retain in Git after catalog authentication. Missing or changed
archive bytes reject. The original failed intake and diagnosis remain available.

The dated display reader also retains a receipt for an earlier publication
programme. Comparing that historical receipt with today's legitimately extended
programme fails. Its explicit dated adapter now reconstructs the complete
source/native/instrument context and freshly executes the unchanged reader with
the exact original programme from Git. Every input byte conserves before and
after execution. The earlier display recipe below uses this adapter; complete
current/native verification remains a separate obligation. The first actual
current-context refusal retains its full programme and streams.

Replay this complete dated prerequisite qualification:

```bash
scripts/run_with_ram_guard.sh -- python3 -B docs/audits/raw-stack-prerequisites-20261011/verify.py
```

Only the finite observer and class/frame predecessor containers close here.
The complete raw-stack semantic join and its publication remain separately
owned. Original native class, provider, hooks, settings, flags, encoding,
private meanings and referent identities remain unmeasured. Cause, consumer,
alias, cold, permanent, host-native and visual qualification remain open;
HIAL and full CI/push gates retain their own prerequisites.

'''


def aggregate(rows):
    return dict(files=len(rows),lines_total=sum(raw.count(b'\n') for raw in rows.values()),
                bytes_total=sum(map(len,rows.values())))


def rendered_addition():
    # The native mdBook renderer applies smart punctuation to this sole
    # authored apostrophe. This exact book-text seam does not normalize any
    # original raw error or source/native semantic product.
    need(ADDITION.count("today's")==1,'unique authored book typography seam')
    text=ADDITION.replace("today's",'today’s',1)
    return ' '.join(line for line in text.splitlines() if not line.startswith('```'))


def source():
    names=[name for name in git('ls-tree','-r','--name-only',REVISION,'--','docs/book/src').decode().splitlines()
           if Path(name).parent==Path('docs/book/src') and name.endswith('.md')]
    before={name:git('show',REVISION+':'+name) for name in names};after=dict(before)
    text=before[str(CHAPTER)].decode();need(text.count(ANCHOR)==1 and ADDITION not in text,'unique original prerequisite book seam')
    text=text.replace(ANCHOR,ANCHOR+ADDITION,1)
    for old,new in TRANSFORMS.items():
        need(text.count(old)==1,'unique historical display recipe correction')
        text=text.replace(old,new,1)
    after[str(CHAPTER)]=text.encode()
    return before,after


def authority(before,after):
    a,b=aggregate(before),aggregate(after)
    return dict(authority_id='RAW-STACK-PREREQUISITES-20261011',owner=OWNER,baseline=a,
                delta={key:b[key]-a[key] for key in a},
                rationale='Document complete unchanged observer/class-frame predecessor and raw prerequisite acceptance, exact required archive recovery and genuine controls; complete raw semantics and original native/private identities remain open.')


def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__);parser.add_argument('--publish',action='store_true');parser.add_argument('--repair',action='store_true');parser.add_argument('--native',action='store_true');args=parser.parse_args()
    before,after=source();current={str(path):path.read_bytes() for path in Path('docs/book/src').glob('*.md')}
    if args.publish or args.repair:
        if args.repair:
            initial=json.loads((BASE/'book-publication.json').read_bytes())
            need({k:pin(v) for k,v in current.items()}==initial['after']
                 and current[str(CHAPTER)]==(BASE/'book-first-chapter.md.txt').read_bytes(),
                 'complete first prerequisite guide/native epoch retained before recipe repair')
        else:need(current==before,'sole owned prerequisite guide mutation')
        CHAPTER.write_bytes(after[str(CHAPTER)])
        rows=[json.loads(line) for line in REGISTRY.read_bytes().splitlines()]
        selected=next(row for row in rows if row.get('surface_id')=='shipped_behavior')
        selected['reference_contract']['aggregate_change']=authority(before,after)
        REGISTRY.write_text(''.join(json.dumps(row,sort_keys=True)+'\n' for row in rows))
        save('book-publication-qualified.json' if args.repair else 'book-publication.json',dict(revision=REVISION,before={k:pin(v) for k,v in before.items()},
             after={k:pin(v) for k,v in after.items()},authority=authority(before,after),addition=ADDITION))
        print('PASS sole whole prerequisite book addition and exact fresh aggregate authority; ceilings unchanged.')
    else:
        need(current==after,'complete prerequisite book and unchanged source peers')
        if args.native:
            class Text(HTMLParser):
                def __init__(self):super().__init__();self.parts=[]
                def handle_data(self,value):self.parts.append(value)
            raw=Path('docs/book/book/13k-isf-feature-support-matrix.html').read_bytes();reader=Text();reader.feed(raw.decode())
            rendered=rendered_addition()
            need(' '.join(''.join(reader.parts).split()).count(' '.join(rendered.split()))==1,'whole unique rendered prerequisite guide')
            need(not (BASE/'book-native-final.html.gz').exists(),'retain complete first qualified prerequisite native guide')
            (BASE/'book-native-final.html.gz').write_bytes(gzip.compress(raw,mtime=0))
            save('book-native-final.json',dict(chapter=pin(raw),addition=pin(ADDITION.encode()),scope='Whole native guidance and source custody; visual QA remains open.'))
        print('PASS complete whole prerequisite book/source/native guide; visual QA remains separately owned.')


if __name__=='__main__':main()

"""Complete external gate receipts; expected diagnostics remain visible."""
import json
import fcntl
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from common import BASE, canonical, need, pin


if __name__ == '__main__':
    need(len(sys.argv)>=3, 'named check and explicit command')
    name,command=sys.argv[1],sys.argv[2:]
    path=BASE/'checks.json'
    lock_path=Path('.artifacts/raw-stack-prerequisites-20261011/checks.lock')
    lock_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    with lock_path.open('a+b') as lock:
        fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX)
        saved=json.loads(path.read_bytes()) if path.exists() else {}
        need(name not in saved, 'retain first complete check result')
    inputs={str(p):pin(p.read_bytes()) for p in sorted(BASE.glob('*.py'))}
    inputs.update({arg:pin(Path(arg).read_bytes()) for arg in command if Path(arg).is_file()})
    indirect = [Path(name) for name in (
        'scripts/check_record_value_publication.py',
        'scripts/record_value_observer_fact.py',
        'scripts/record_value_observer_namespace_fact.py',
        't/python/test_record_value_current_publication.py',
        'docs/knowledge/record-value-original-observer-helper-paths.md',
        'docs/book/src/13k-isf-feature-support-matrix.md')]
    inputs.update({str(path):pin(path.read_bytes()) for path in indirect})
    result=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True,text=True)
    after={path:pin(Path(path).read_bytes()) for path in inputs}
    # Commands may run independently; only this short read/merge/write is
    # serialized. Reload after the child so an older invocation cannot erase
    # a receipt completed while it was running.
    with lock_path.open('a+b') as lock:
        fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX)
        saved=json.loads(path.read_bytes()) if path.exists() else {}
        need(name not in saved, 'retain first complete check result')
        saved[name]=dict(command=command,status=result.returncode,stdout=result.stdout,stderr=result.stderr,
                         inputs=inputs,inputs_after=after,epoch_conserved=after==inputs)
        path.write_bytes(canonical(saved))
    print(name,result.returncode,result.stdout[-1400:],result.stderr[-1800:],flush=True)
    need(after==inputs,'complete direct and declared indirect source epoch conserved')
    need(type(result.returncode) is int and result.returncode==0,'external check success: '+name)

"""Reexecute the whole old display reader in its exact dated instrument context."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
import shutil
import stat
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from common import BASE, REVISION, canonical, load, need, pin, save
from intake import git

ROOT=Path('.artifacts/raw-stack-prerequisites-20261011/display-checkpoint')
DISPLAY=Path('docs/audits/observer-display-contract-20261010')
ORIGINAL='a9fa6d6955797577c6be8fd54c1c6a507e48a526'
INSTRUMENT='scripts/check_record_value_publication.py'
SUCCESS='PASS complete fresh dated display-reader execution and whole fixed source/instrument conservation; maintained current/native verification remains separate.\n'


def preflight():
    root=Path.cwd().resolve();full=root/ROOT
    need(not ROOT.is_absolute() and not {'..','.git'}.intersection(ROOT.parts) and full.resolve()==full,
         'plain own dated checkpoint path before any write')
    for parent in (full,*full.parents):
        if parent==root:break
        need(not (parent/'.git').exists(),'own dated checkpoint repository boundary before any write')
    nearest=full
    while not nearest.exists():nearest=nearest.parent
    need(nearest.is_dir() and nearest.stat().st_dev==root.stat().st_dev,
         'ordinary same-volume dated checkpoint parent before any write')


def identity(path):
    digest=hashlib.sha256();size=0
    with path.open('rb') as stream:
        while chunk:=stream.read(1048576):digest.update(chunk);size+=len(chunk)
    return dict(bytes=size,sha256=digest.hexdigest())


def expected():
    fixed=load('intake-qualified.json')['members']
    prerequisite=json.loads((DISPLAY/'prerequisites.json').read_bytes())
    checks=json.loads((DISPLAY/'checks.json').read_bytes())
    roots=set(prerequisite['custody']['roots'])|{str(DISPLAY)}
    roots.update(path for record in checks.values() for path in record['instruments'])
    members={path:dict(bytes=row['bytes'],sha256=row['sha256'],executable=row['mode']=='100755')
             for path,row in fixed.items() if any(path==root or path.startswith(root+'/') for root in roots)}
    need(all(any(path==root or path.startswith(root+'/') for path in members) for root in roots),
         'complete dated display prerequisite/direct instrument roots')
    original=git('show',ORIGINAL+':'+INSTRUMENT)
    need(pin(original)==checks['current-publication']['instruments'][INSTRUMENT],
         'exact old display publication instrument from immutable Git and original actual receipt')
    need(members[INSTRUMENT]['sha256']!=pin(original)['sha256'],
         'genuine legitimate old and current publication programme epochs differ')
    members[INSTRUMENT]=dict(**pin(original),executable=members[INSTRUMENT]['executable'])
    return members,original


def census(expected_members):
    result={};root=Path.cwd().resolve();directories=set()
    for path in sorted(ROOT.rglob('*')):
        mode=path.lstat().st_mode
        need(path.resolve()==root/path and path.stat().st_dev==root.stat().st_dev
             and not (path/'.git').exists(),'own same-volume dated display checkpoint graph')
        if stat.S_ISDIR(mode):directories.add(str(path.relative_to(ROOT)));continue
        need(stat.S_ISREG(mode),'ordinary complete dated display checkpoint member')
        result[str(path.relative_to(ROOT))]=dict(**identity(path),executable=bool(mode&0o111))
    wanted={str(parent) for name in expected_members for parent in Path(name).parents if str(parent)!='.'}
    need(directories==wanted,'whole dated display checkpoint directory graph')
    return result


def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__);parser.add_argument('--replay',action='store_true');args=parser.parse_args()
    members,original=expected()
    preflight()
    fresh=not ROOT.exists()
    need(args.replay or fresh,'retain complete first dated display checkpoint')
    ROOT.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=args.replay)
    for name,record in members.items():
        target=ROOT/name
        if target.exists():continue
        need(fresh,'replay does not repair missing checkpoint evidence')
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
        if name==INSTRUMENT:target.write_bytes(original)
        else:shutil.copyfile(name,target)
        target.chmod(0o755 if record['executable'] else 0o644)
    before=census(members);need(before==members,'whole copied fixed source/native/direct instrument byte epoch')
    command=['python3','-B',str(DISPLAY/'verify.py')]
    actual=subprocess.run(command,cwd=ROOT,capture_output=True,text=True)
    after=census(members)
    record=dict(command=command,cwd=str(ROOT),status=actual.returncode,stdout=actual.stdout,stderr=actual.stderr,
                fixed_revision=REVISION,original_instrument_revision=ORIGINAL,members=members,
                before=before,after=after,meaning='Complete freshly executed historical display reader under its original direct instrument context. No live file is replaced, original execution recaptured or current programme relabeled historical.')
    if not args.replay:
        number=len(list(BASE.glob('display-checkpoint-actual-*.json')))+1
        save('display-checkpoint-actual-'+str(number)+'.json',record)
    print(actual.stdout,end='');print(actual.stderr,end='',file=sys.stderr)
    need(type(actual.returncode) is int and actual.returncode==0 and actual.stderr==''
         and actual.stdout=='PASS entire finite public source/display/body/loss/lifetime contracts, genuine controls, all first failures and whole fixed/current source custody; original observer/settings identity remains unmeasured.\n',
         'actual complete dated display reader success')
    need(before==after,'dated display reader conserves every whole input and creates no artifact')
    if (BASE/'display-checkpoint.json').exists():need(load('display-checkpoint.json')==record,'whole fixed dated display actual result')
    else:
        need(not args.replay,'dated replay requires its committed original result')
        save('display-checkpoint.json',record)
    print(SUCCESS,end='')


if __name__=='__main__':main()

"""Bind the complete fixed prerequisite domain before semantic reexecution."""
import hashlib
import json
import os
import stat
import subprocess
import tarfile
from pathlib import Path
from common import BASE, CLASS, OBSERVER, RAW, REVISION, SCOPE, canonical, need, pin, save

RECOVERY='docs/audits/coordinate-public-route-checks-20261008/drafts.tar.gz'


def recovery(path=Path(RECOVERY)):
    """Recover a required ignored payload against its already committed catalog."""
    catalog_raw=git('show',REVISION+':'+str(Path(RECOVERY).with_suffix('').with_suffix('.json')))
    catalog=json.loads(catalog_raw)
    actual=regular(path,'100644').read_bytes()
    need(pin(actual)==catalog['archive'],'complete recovered archive fixed-catalog byte identity')
    with tarfile.open(path) as archive:
        members=archive.getmembers()
        names=[member.name for member in members]
        need(len(names)==len(set(names)) and set(names)==set(catalog['members'])
             and all(member.isfile() for member in members),'complete recovered archive regular member graph')
        wanted={member.name:pin(archive.extractfile(member).read()) for member in members}
    need(wanted==catalog['members'],'complete recovered archive member byte identity')
    return dict(catalog=pin(catalog_raw),archive=pin(actual),members=wanted,
                provenance='Previously ignored payload; exact committed e428 catalog authenticates recovery. Not a Git blob at that checkpoint.')


def git(*arguments):
    actual=subprocess.run(['git','--no-replace-objects',*arguments],capture_output=True)
    need(type(actual.returncode) is int and actual.returncode==0 and actual.stderr==b'','complete fixed raw prerequisite Git protocol')
    return actual.stdout


def roots():
    directory=Path('docs/audits')
    raw=json.loads(git('show',REVISION+':'+str(directory/'record-value-original-raw-20261005/binding.json')))
    classes=json.loads(git('show',REVISION+':'+str(directory/'record-value-class-frame-join-20261006/binding.json')))
    address=json.loads(git('show',REVISION+':'+str(directory/'address-raw-admission-20261010/admission.json')))
    selected=set(raw['archives'])|set(classes['inputs'])|set(address['custody']['roots'])
    names=git('ls-tree','-d','--name-only',REVISION+':docs/audits').decode().splitlines()
    families=('observer-','coordinate-','record-value-coordinate-','address-')
    selected.update(str(directory/name) for name in names if name.startswith(families))
    selected.update(str(directory/name) for name in ('record-value-original-raw-20261005',
        'record-value-class-frame-join-20261006','record-value-class-frame-publication-20261006'))
    selected.update(['scripts/check_record_value_publication.py','scripts/record_value_observer_fact.py',
        'scripts/record_value_observer_namespace_fact.py','scripts/record_value_address_fact.py',
        'scripts/record_value_coordinate_fact.py','t/python/test_record_value_current_publication.py'])
    display=json.loads(git('show',REVISION+':docs/audits/observer-display-contract-20261010/checks.json'))
    selected.update(path for actual in display.values() for path in actual['instruments'])
    return sorted(path for path in selected if not any(path.startswith(other+'/') for other in selected if path!=other))


def regular(path,mode):
    root=Path.cwd().resolve();full=root/path
    need(not path.is_absolute() and not {'..','.git'}.intersection(path.parts),'own relative raw prerequisite path')
    need(full.resolve()==full and stat.S_ISREG(full.lstat().st_mode) and full.stat().st_dev==root.stat().st_dev,
         'ordinary same-volume raw prerequisite input')
    for parent in full.parents:
        if parent==root:break
        need(not (parent/'.git').exists(),'raw prerequisite repository boundary')
    need(bool(full.stat().st_mode&0o111)==(mode=='100755'),'complete raw prerequisite executable mode')
    return full


def derive():
    selected=roots();raw=git('--literal-pathspecs','ls-tree','-r','-z',REVISION,'--',*selected)
    entries={}
    for record in raw.rstrip(b'\0').split(b'\0'):
        head,name=record.split(b'\t',1);mode,kind,oid=head.decode().split();path=name.decode()
        need(mode in ('100644','100755') and kind=='blob' and path not in entries,'complete regular raw prerequisite member population')
        entries[path]=dict(mode=mode,oid=oid)
    process=subprocess.Popen(['git','--no-replace-objects','cat-file','--batch'],stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    ledger={}
    try:
        for name,entry in sorted(entries.items()):
            path=regular(Path(name),entry['mode']);before=path.stat()
            process.stdin.write(entry['oid'].encode()+b'\n');process.stdin.flush()
            oid,kind,size=process.stdout.readline().split()
            need(oid.decode()==entry['oid'] and kind==b'blob' and int(size)==before.st_size,'whole fixed/current raw prerequisite object')
            remaining=int(size);digest=hashlib.sha256()
            with path.open('rb') as stream:
                while remaining:
                    chunk=process.stdout.read(min(1048576,remaining))
                    need(bool(chunk) and stream.read(len(chunk))==chunk,'whole fixed/current raw prerequisite bytes')
                    digest.update(chunk);remaining-=len(chunk)
                need(stream.read(1)==b'' and process.stdout.read(1)==b'\n','complete raw prerequisite object boundary')
            after=path.stat()
            need((before.st_dev,before.st_ino,before.st_size,before.st_mtime_ns)==
                 (after.st_dev,after.st_ino,after.st_size,after.st_mtime_ns),'complete raw prerequisite source epoch conserved')
            ledger[name]=dict(**entry,bytes=int(size),sha256=digest.hexdigest())
        process.stdin.close();error=process.stderr.read();status=process.wait()
        need(type(status) is int and status==0 and error==b'' and process.stdout.read(1)==b'','complete raw prerequisite binary Git stream')
    finally:
        if process.poll() is None:process.kill();process.wait()
    observed=set()
    for selected_path in selected:

            observed.update(str(base/name) for name in files)
    need(observed==set(entries)|{RECOVERY},'complete current and fixed raw prerequisite member graph plus exact owned recovery')
    recovered=recovery()
    return dict(revision=REVISION,roots=selected,members=ledger,recovery={RECOVERY:recovered},
                task=pin(git('show',REVISION+':docs/tasks/SEMANTIC-INTROSPECTION-MCP-FRONTIER.md')),scope=SCOPE)

AUDITS=Path('docs/audits')

def blocks(text):
    matches=list(re.finditer(r'^- ID: `([^`]+)`\n.*?(?=^- ID: |\Z)',text,re.M|re.S))
    result={m[1]:m[0] for m in matches}
    need(len(result)==len(matches),'unique complete original predecessor task identities')
    return result


def fields(body):
    return {key:re.search(r'^  '+key+r': `(.*)`$',body,re.M)[1]
            for key in ('Goal','Acceptance','Children') if re.search(r'^  '+key+':',body,re.M)}


def contracts():
    fixed=git('show',REVISION+':'+str(TASK));nodes=blocks(fixed.decode());pending=[CLASS];forest={}
    while pending:
        key=pending.pop();need(key not in forest,'acyclic full predecessor forest')
        forest[key]=nodes[key]
        pending.extend(re.findall(r'SEMANTIC-INTROSPECTION-MCP-FRONTIER[.0-9]*',fields(nodes[key]).get('Children','')))
    need(all('  Status: `done`\n' in body for key,body in forest.items() if key not in (CLASS,OBSERVER)),
         'every original observer/class-frame child completed before predecessor closure')
    return dict(revision=REVISION,task=pin(fixed),forest=forest,
                raw_containers={key:nodes[key] for key in (RAW,RAW+'.5')},scope=SCOPE)

             'every complete predecessor child remains done')

def derive(source,qualified,native,headers,expressions):

                phases.append(dict(phase=pi,family=phase['family'],inferred_class=phase['inferred_class'],
                                   guard=phase['guard_source'],roles=roles))
            need(case['exception']['source_family']==case['phases'][-1]['family'],

Complete quoting/truncation falsification is the separate original-header lexical reader; no universal language or native identity oracle is asserted.')

import ast

def read(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_bytes())


def terminal(path):
    tree=ast.parse(Path(path).read_bytes())
    constants={target.id:node.value.value for node in tree.body if isinstance(node,ast.Assign)
               and isinstance(node.value,ast.Constant) and isinstance(node.value.value,str)
               for target in node.targets if isinstance(target,ast.Name)}
    if 'SUCCESS' in constants:return constants['SUCCESS']
    found=[node for node in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(node,ast.Call)
           and isinstance(node.func,ast.Name) and node.func.id=='print' and node.args
           and isinstance(node.args[0],ast.Constant) and isinstance(node.args[0].value,str)
           and node.args[0].value.startswith('PASS ')]
    need(bool(found),'fixed reader terminal source literal')
    return max(found,key=lambda node:node.lineno).args[0].value+'\n'

def execute(label, command):

    programs = {str(p):dict(identity=pin(p.read_bytes()), body=p.read_text())
                for p in sorted(BASE.iterdir()) if p.suffix in ('.py', '.pl')}
    # A guard may terminate the entire process tree. Persist the exact
    # command and complete programme epoch before starting any child.
    save('started-'+label+'-'+str(number)+'.json',dict(command=command,programs=programs,
        scope='Pre-execution source and command admission only; no outcome is asserted.'))
